Draw from a conjugate posterior predictive distribution

bf_predict.Rd

Draws a parameter from the posterior for each replicate and then samples a future observation from the corresponding likelihood. The result captures uncertainty in both the parameter and the future observation.

Usage

bf_predict(object, n = 4000, trials = NULL, exposure = NULL, obs_sd = NULL)

Arguments

object

A bf_posterior from a Beta-Binomial, Gamma-Poisson, or Normal-Normal model.

n

Positive integer number of predictive draws.

trials

Future trial count for a Beta posterior (default 1).

exposure

Future exposure for a Gamma posterior (default 1).

obs_sd

Future observation standard deviation for a Normal posterior. By default uses the value stored by normal_normal_posterior().

Value

A numeric vector of predictive draws.

Examples

prior <- bf_prior("gamma", list(shape = 2, rate = 1))
post <- gamma_poisson_posterior(prior, c(3, 4, 2))
future <- bf_predict(post, exposure = 30)
mean(future > 100)
#> [1] 0.2365
